quote: If you are a real estate agent who has no value outside of your ability to operate a lock box, my prediction is that in the next 18 to 24 months, you will be reclassified as a gig worker.
why_clipworthy: Challenges agents to rethink their value proposition in the face of AI advancements.
suggested_hook: Are you at risk of becoming the DoorDash driver of real estate?
